annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They'll probably want the plain facts
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd like to ask whether I can meet them and answer
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask whether I can meet them and answer whatever they ask

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five men might be carrying a strange sort of guilt
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: as if they owe something they never asked for
annotations.ce_supportive_use: tell them it was my call, not theirs to carry

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the other rail staff expect me to either defend it hard
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'll talk to them openly so the crew can keep trusting

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: may well want someone to sit with her and say his name
annotations.ce_supportive_use: If she'd allow it, I'd go.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: want someone to sit with her and say his name

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably assume I think they're to blame
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd tell them that face to face, so they can go back
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so they can go back to work without that weight

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: likely believe nobody up here even knew who he was
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd ask to attend whatever gathering they hold for him

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: often want to know it wasn't careless
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd explain how it unfolded, if she wants that
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd explain how it unfolded, if she wants that

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: will probably want to believe their dad mattered
annotations.ce_supportive_use: make sure they hear that he did
annotations.pda_repair_intention: helping set up something in his name

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd guess he thinks he should have spotted the problem sooner
annotations.ce_supportive_use: make sure he isn't quietly blaming himself

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They may be expecting silence from me, or excuses
annotations.ce_supportive_use: just an honest offer to talk whenever they're ready
annotations.pda_repair_intention: write to the family of the man on the side track
